title: SYCOPHANCY IS NOT ONE THING: CAUSAL SEPARATION OF SYCOPHANTIC BEHAVIORS IN LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting difference-in-means (DiffMean) directions from residual stream activations to identify distinct behavioral subspaces for sycophantic agreement, genuine agreement, and sycophantic praise, and measuring their causal separability via activation addition (steering vectors) and subspace ablation on synthetic datasets and the SycophancyEval benchmark.
